description: This file defines the FileExtensionEscapingStrategy class in the Twig templating engine. It provides a method to determine the appropriate autoescaping strategy based on the file name extension, defaulting to HTML but changing behavior for specific extensions like JavaScript, JSON, CSS, and text files.

classes.name: FileExtensionEscapingStrategy
classes.description: Provides a static method to guess the autoescaping strategy based on filename extensions.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Guesses the best autoescaping strategy based on the template filename extension.
